notes.title: New Update Allows Shadows To Be Turned Off
notes.notes:
Version 1.00291 Allows "Shadows" to be turned off in OPTIONS.

Some players mentioned flickering shadows with their system. Not sure why some video cards cause flickering shadows while others do not. But newest version allows players to turn off shadows in the options now.

Enjoy.

Also, if you enjoy Bloodlust you may want to check out my other vampire games on steam, "Bloodlust Nemesis" and "Lost City of Vampires"

notes.notes:

Even though its released...I will be making more updates if necessary. 

Thanks

notes.title: Bloodlust after 5 months in Early Access
notes.notes:
New update allows easier hotbar manipulation.

Apologize for all the daily updates. I know this can be frustrating and recommend setting Bloodlust to update only prior to starting game.

Most players probably are not finding any game breaking bugs... however some players are, and because it's extremely difficult to let gamebreaking bugs go weeks without fixing,  these bugs need to be fixed immediately and that is the reason for so many updates. 

(Once the game is released there will not be as many updates.)

After 4 years in development and 5 months in EA most of the content and enhancments are complete (What you see now is pretty much the completed game)- just looking for any last minute bugs and once satisified Bloodlust will release soon.

Bloodlust is actually 2 years overdue... and was never designed to be as big a project as it ended up being (it never does) ... It was originally designed to be a small 1 random dungeon game with 2 classes and a couple NPC's and somehow ended up being so much bigger. (there were a few things that didnt make it in that I really wanted... such as CO-OP more character customization, etc. - but because of the small scope of this production... it just cant be... perhaps in Bloodlust 2.. LOL!)

Want to thank all the players who have contributed to helping finding bugs.. please let me know if you see anything else.

Thanks
Bill

notes.title: New end-game content - 4 Shadowhunter Skills Added
notes.notes:
New end-game content has been added to newest version.


*** SPOILIER ALERT ****
*** SPOILIER ALERT ****
*** SPOILIER ALERT ****
*** SPOILIER ALERT ****
*** SPOILIER ALERT ****


If you decide to destroy Ranior you obviously become mortal again and therefore you lose all of your vampire skills - However since you are really a Shadowhunter you naturally gain access to unique Shadowhunter Skills.

Shadowhunter breed specifics -

- Darker Skin with Glowing Blue Eyes
- Naturally resistant to Light, Fire, and Silver
- Very low thirst rate 
- Only recieve 3 stat points during levelup (Slower Learners?)
- 4 Unique Shadowhunter skills
- Stronger Skills however unlike Vampires, Shadowhunters can be killed (can only be revived in the Tomb)


If you have an existing character that has already destroyed Ranior - go into the Secret Chamber location to turn into the new breed.

notes.notes:
Early Access has been great for finding bugs and adding some new content. Want to thank players for their help with finding bugs and suggestions for new features/content.

notes.title: Bloodlust - New Update 1.4.4B
notes.notes:
Bloodlust - New Update 1.4.4B
1.4.4B
-------------------------------------------------
- Secret Sight level 3+ allows you to see in dark without flashlight ("Night Sight")

Full green screen effect of Secret sight has been changed to a green border only. It also does not require any particular Rep to level up. (This was done so "night sight" can be turned on and off... since the effect washes out the ambient lighting of all locations and ruins the subtle experience so needs to be more of a temporary effect - Night Sight is always active in dungeon areas without secret sight)

- Fixed unlimted keycards from desk clerk
- Fixed wrong notes showing code at bottom
- Adjusted jump delay timer to be shorter
- Farok cannot be killed
- Sarx no longer randomly teleports as much when fighting
- Paco should no longer be found inside collumn (???)
- Fixed flashlight slot text from reading "Weapon"
- Fixed some areas in Courtyard and North Sewers
- Add 2 girls to couches
- Misc other fixes

1.4.4.2B
-------------------------------------------------
- Minions are claustraphobic message appears when getting on elevator (sending them away)
- No longer can jump on table in Scades Hideout
- Added some paintings
- Warning Message when putting "Quest" items into chests
- Fixed dialog with Varok in theater
- New secret area in Hotel
- Press SHIFT to fire only one stake (However additional "stakestorm" ammo is free anyway)
- Reinforcement "Red Guards" spawn (Only red guards now - but probably need to do this for other guards too)

1.4.4.3
-------------------------------------------------
- New Area Asylum

1.4.4.4
-------------------------------------------------
- New Recycler Machine (Add 4 items to gamble for another item. More items included increase chances for better equipment plus another item)

1.4.4.5
------------------------------------------
- Recycler Machine - only requires 3 items (4+ gives better chance to find RARE/UNIQUE)
- Hotel is now under construction so it makes more sense that there is only one room
- Asylum gaps fixed
- Misc other fixes

1.4.4.6
-------------------------------------------
- Added Asylum Basement (7th Random Dungeon Area - better loot)
- New enemy "Blood Bot" (steals Blood) added to Asylum Basement

notes.title: Premature Evaluation: BloodLust Shadowhunter
notes.notes:
Each week Marsh Davies runs shrieking from the burning sun and into the dark embrace of Early Access, coming back with any stories he can find and/or an inexplicable desire to wear fishnets, a top-hat and tinted pince-nez while hanging around in abandoned Chinese restaurants. This week, let it not be said that BloodLust Shadowhunter s name is too subtle an evocation of vampire fiction. It is, however, a surprisingly rich thirdperson RPG with a mix of dungeon crawling, urban squalor and janky make-do charm.

I never went through a Goth phase as a kid, but videogames make me wish I had. I can t help but find their nighttime cityscapes entrancing – even the squalid backalleys of BloodLust Shadowhunter, with their grimy brickwork, sallow sodium lights, overfilled dumpsters and yesteryear polycounts. Perhaps it s because, in games, such lonely streets are so often the player s domain. Perhaps it s because hours of squinting at Sam Fisher s rubberised buns have trained me to see shadowy, deserted places as a source of empowerment, from which the populace world can be observed and navigated on my terms. Or perhaps it s because BloodLustShadowhunter is my middle name. Yes, there is that, I suppose.
